rankings.blurb: Six cornerstones, eleven cornerstones-plus-foundational, and a WR room that makes everyone else want to quit — Ja'Marr Chase, JSN, and Drake London on the same roster is just obscene. Jayden Daniels, Justin Herbert, AND Trevor Lawrence at QB means Sven can survive injury apocalypses that would end lesser dynasties. De'Von Achane and Omarion Hampton in the backfield? This team is built like a tank with nitrous injectors. The only knock is a thin pick cabinet and some recent trade Ls, but when your player roster looks like this, who cares about picks?

Drake Maye, Jahmyr Gibbs, Puka Nacua, and Trey McBride in the same starting lineup is a murder weapon — four cornerstones with elite upside and legitimate win-now pop. The Gibbs acquisition cost a haul of picks that would make most owners faint, but when the guy goes for 9,911 KTC you can argue the price was worth it. Depth is thin — only one first-round pick remaining — and the roster gets shaky fast after the top six, but the ceiling here is as high as anyone in the league. If ekleiner runs hot on Cam Ward and Jonathon Brooks, this team becomes genuinely scary.

Seven first-round picks and a Reload tag means jsinykin is cooking something sinister in the lab — Caleb Williams and Jaxson Dart at QB is an embarrassment of riches most teams would kill for. Jeremiyah Love, Quinshon Judkins, and Harold Fannin are all Upside Premier players who could be top-three at their positions in two years. The WR room is deep with Egbuka, Olave, and Luther Burden, and that pick arsenal gives jsinykin max trade leverage. This team isn't quite contending yet, but with Caleb Williams under center and a war chest of capital, the trajectory is aggressively up.

Josh Allen at 9,998 KTC is the single most valuable player in this league and he's on gavinw20's roster — that alone buys you some respect. Ashton Jeanty alongside James Cook gives this team a stacked backfield, and Bo Nix as a QB2 is a luxury most teams can't afford. The WR corps of Garrett Wilson, Zay Flowers, and Jaylen Waddle is solidly Foundational but not blowing anyone's doors off, and the TE room beyond LaPorta is thin. Trading away Tyler Shough and a first for Garrett Wilson and Baker Mayfield is a weird vibes move but whatever, Josh Allen makes everything better.

Joe Burrow and Amon-Ra St. Brown is a legitimate nucleus, and adding Jalen Hurts via trade gave this team real QB depth — but then GiantHawkTua turned around and got absolutely FLEECED by nchernandez19, surrendering Jameson Williams plus TWO future firsts for Malik Willis and Michael Wilson like some kind of fever dream. Zero first-round picks owned is a five-alarm dynasty fire, and the roster gets old fast with Jonathan Taylor, Breece Hall, and Kenneth Walker all sliding toward their windows closing. This team can compete right now but the foundation underneath them is crumbling like a wet cracker.

Bijan Robinson and Brock Bowers as cornerstones is an incredible start, and nchernandez19 has been an absolute SHARK in the trade market — fleecing GiantHawkTua for two firsts, farming Sven for picks, and stacking six first-rounders to go along with that elite duo. Jordan Love is a legit QB1, Marvin Harrison and Jameson Williams give you WR upside, and Tucker Kraft is a sneaky-good TE2. The non-QB positional grades are painfully thin right now and this is clearly a roster mid-rebuild, but with Bijan, Bowers, six firsts, and a GM who clearly wins trades, this ship is pointed in the right direction.

Justin Jefferson and CeeDee Lamb at WR is genuinely elite and keeps this team relevant, but everything else on this roster is held together with duct tape and prayers. Brock Purdy, Jared Goff, and Sam Darnold at QB is the most cursed depth chart in the league — that's three guys you're praying don't get hurt simultaneously. Christian McCaffrey and Saquon Barkley are on the wrong side of 30 and GreyWaedekin27 has almost no picks to reload with, just one first and a prayer. The TE situation is Brenton Strange and Cade Otton, which sounds like a rejected Coen Brothers movie and not a championship-caliber depth chart.

Lamar Jackson AND Patrick Mahomes at QB is genuinely unhinged in the best way possible — two actual MVPs on the same roster — but this team has literally zero future draft picks, which means Herschey6153 is one bad season away from a full-blown catastrophe with no way out. The RB room is Derrick Henry (aging out), Josh Jacobs (serviceable at best), and Tony Pollard (thoughts and prayers), which is not a winning formula. A.J. Brown, Tee Higgins, and Ladd McConkey at WR is solid, but Travis Kelce at TE is more of a retirement ceremony than a dynasty asset. This window is open right now but the hinges are already rusting off.

Akracoon sold Ja'Marr Chase — the highest-value WR in this entire league — for Ladd McConkey and two firsts, which is the kind of move that either looks genius or gets you laughed out of the chat forever, and right now it's looking like the latter. Malik Nabers is a legitimate cornerstone to build around, but the rest of this roster is Fernando Mendoza, Bhayshul Tuten, and Kyle Monangai, which reads like a UDFA waiver wire column. Seven first-round picks is a war chest that gives real hope, but the player grades across the board are bottom-tier and the positional averages are among the worst in the league. Akracoon is speed-running a rebuild and hoping the picks hit — godspeed, king, you're gonna need it.

Congrats to sethfriedman12 for winning the Jahmyr Gibbs trade and walking away from ekleiner1123 with a suitcase full of picks, because that's about the only thing keeping this team out of a full obituary. The actual player roster is a graveyard of Upside Shots and Serviceables — Tyler Shough is your QB1, Aaron Rodgers is your QB2, and Quinn Ewers is somehow your QB3, which is less a quarterback room and more a cry for help. George Pickens is the only player here with real dynasty pop, and five first-round picks give sethfriedman12 a path back to relevance. Right now though, this team is eating from the discount bin while everyone else dines at the penthouse.
